create_Compare: create a Compare instance from a list of Measurement objects to aggregate and display benchmark results
build_Compare_table: build a benchmark comparison table from Measurement results grouped by label with configurable formatting
test_Compare_colorize: test the Compare colorize method to highlight best values in columnwise or rowwise mode
review_Compare_render: review the Compare render method to format benchmark results with time units, warnings, and column alignment
summarize_Compare_print: summarize benchmark results by printing a Compare instance with colorized output and variance warnings
